prompts.intent: Prepare optional licensed albums with exact original and derivative lineage
prompts.prompt: Apply {{ALBUM_BRIEF}} to the existing finite community-album source contract. Inspect actual creator/license pages, preserve conflicting archived terms and any dated correction, and retain original hashes, credits and exact derivative parent/codec/encoder records. Count each composition once across formats and distinguish licensed works from original RevealLine compositions. Do not rename OGG to MP3 or silently transcode a rejected upload; use an explicitly recorded authoring derivative only when authorized and available. Run the existing source compiler into a new cache directory, compare the complete four-album catalog and body pins, and enforce 64 MiB per album. Keep originals/encoder tools outside automatic game includes and binary albums outside core precache and legacy pack metadata. In Studio use Browse, Add to draft, optional audition and explicit Save; a complete .rlsound file restore remains replacement. Preserve all earlier drafts, selection and playback. Report source/codec checks separately from native playback, offline evidence and human listening/loop/mix approval; do not invent a finished-track or release claim.
prompts.example_request: Apply soundtrack-06-optional-licensed-albums with ALBUM_BRIEF=Review the four retained community albums and original-byte lineage.

prompts.intent: Verify additive album continuity, cancellation and shared storage admission
prompts.prompt: Verify {{DRAFT_CASE}} against the actual optional-album flow. Begin with saved music, an applied draft edit, unapplied text and a merely selected playlist. Browse metadata without audio, then Add one album while preserving the draft/assets/saved generation captured before await. Require direct HTTP 200, bounded exact body bytes/hash/library identity and complete native preparation before publishing the union. Exercise cancellation before a deferred response and during body cleanup, finite incomplete cleanup, disposal, stable-ID conflicts and re-adding identical records. Preserve current song, position, selection and assignments; no Add action may save or play. Verify keyboard focus returns only when the same dialog/operation still owns it and deliberate navigation is respected. Hold a real picture/story reservation and prove shared 256 MiB admission refuses Save without releasing another domain or replacing existing audio; a stale generation must not silently rebase. Explicit Save may commit the union, while file-based .rlsound restore retains replacement behavior. Keep structural/model tests, actual native media/file actions, offline recovery and listening quality separately evidenced.
prompts.example_request: Apply soundtrack-07-album-draft-continuity with DRAFT_CASE=Add a second album while personal edits and current playback are active, then cancel and retry.
